name: Amber's Quest
source:
In the early 20th century, the promise of fame and fortune fuels humanity’s hunger to explore the unknown. Among these dreamers is Amber, a young archaeologist desperate to prove himself. When he uncovers an ancient inscription hinting at a hidden city of unimaginable riches deep in South America, his path becomes clear: he will be the one to find it. Driven by ambition and adventure, Amber sets out with his companions Gabriel and Mateo to navigate the treacherous Colorado River in search of the Lost City of Caesars.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178570/Ambers_Quest/]Steam[/url]]
